# KS-1260 N62-1 / N62-2 PIN THE OBSERVED RATIO, THE LEG-1 NOTE AND THE NONE-DECLARED EXIT — Wednesday's task for Ornith, TEST_ONLY (bash suite), **ONE existing `*.test.sh`, four hunks (the harness's `run_legs` learns two optional lists, three cells added), no product file** (written 2026-09-19, round 12)

File: `Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__/preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio.test.sh`
Tip: `51dbedd39ade43cc511278502b2e1e190de641c7`

Written from develop `51dbedd39ade43cc511278502b2e1e190de641c7` (read with `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop`; #1062 / KS-1260 is merged there and this suite came with it). The suite at that tip is 77 lines; its full content is in `files[...]` of your input. The product the cells pin is `Blockchain/Dev/scripts/preflight/preflight.sh` (778 lines). The suite runs under **`/bin/bash` 3.2** from the repository root.

## THE MODE — read this twice

**TEST_ONLY.** Your diff touches EXACTLY ONE file: the suite above, MODIFIED IN PLACE (`--- a/<path>` / `+++ b/<path>`, the path exactly as written above). You never touch `preflight.sh` or any other file: the behaviour is already right at the tip, and these cells PIN it. A cell is ONE line the suite's own `expect` helper prints (`ok   <desc>` / `FAIL <desc>`); use that helper, never a new one.

## What the cells pin (one paragraph)

The suite builds a harness from preflight.sh's OWN lines (its state and `step()` / `_leg_concluded()` helpers, and its closing verdict) and drives every leg through `step()`. Because every leg it drives reaches a conclusion, three things in the verdict are pinned by nothing: the #1061-#1069 gate (report `2026-09-19-batch1061-1069-tier1-r1`, findings **N62-1** and **N62-2**, Minor) planted **OLDFORMULA** (`:705` prints `$((TOTAL_LEGS - n_skipped))`, KS-1046's retired formula, instead of the OBSERVED `$n_ran`), **ALSOLINENOOP** (`:707`, the `Leg 1 also could not RUN` note, replaced by `:`) and **NONEDECLAREDEXIT0** (`:746`, the `exit 1` of the "NONE declared a skip" INCOMPLETE branch, made `exit 0`), and **0 of 146 cells** in the seven preflight-driving suites went red. This brief gives `run_legs` two OPTIONAL arguments, a third list of legs that fail with no workspace install (`fail=1` and `env_fail=1`, exactly what preflight's leg 1 does at `:236-237`) and a fourth, the last leg driven (default: all of them), and adds three cells: a leg-7 failure with the last leg never driven must print `(14/15 legs ran)`; a leg-1 no-install failure plus a real leg-7 failure must print the `Leg 1 also could not RUN` note; a clean run with the last leg never driven must be INCOMPLETE, say `NONE declared a skip`, and exit 1. Every existing cell is unchanged: with the two new arguments left out, `run_legs` writes the same harness it writes today.

## The exact change — FOUR hunks in the suite

Copy every line byte for byte. Every `+` line is ASCII only. There is no blank line anywhere in the fence. Keep every header exactly as shown. **Your diff MUST begin with the two file-header lines, above the first `@@` line: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__/preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio.test.sh` then `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__/preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio.test.sh`.**

- Hunk 1 (`:42-45`): one comment line added above `run_legs() {`, and the `local` line (`:44`) replaced so it also reads `envfail` (3rd, default empty) and `last` (4th, default `$TOTAL`).
- Hunk 2 (`:47-49`): the loop-header `printf` (`:48`) replaced so the loop runs to `$last` instead of `$TOTAL_LEGS`. The `step` header inside it still says `/$TOTAL_LEGS`, so `step()`'s header check still passes.
- Hunk 3 (`:50-51`): one `printf` line added after the `fail=1` line (`:50`): legs in the third list set `fail=1; env_fail=1`.
- Hunk 4 (`:75`): the three cells, inserted just above the closing `echo ""` (`:75`). There is no leading context line because `:74` is blank.

```

 # script's own skip_stack. Sets RC and writes $tmp/out.txt.
+# KS-1260 N62: an optional 3rd list fails with no install (fail=1 and env_fail=1, as leg 1 does); an optional 4th is the last leg driven.
 run_legs() {
-  local real="$1" skipped="$2"
+  local real="$1" skipped="$2" envfail="${3:-}" last="${4:-$TOTAL}"
   {
@@ -47,3 +48,3 @@
     cat "$tmp/helpers.sh"
-    printf 'n=1\nwhile [ "$n" -le "$TOTAL_LEGS" ]; do\n  step "$n/$TOTAL_LEGS  leg $n"\n'
+    printf 'n=1\nwhile [ "$n" -le %s ]; do\n  step "$n/$TOTAL_LEGS  leg $n"\n' "$last"
     printf '  case " %s " in *" $n "*) skip_stack ;; esac\n' "$skipped"
@@ -50,2 +51,3 @@
     printf '  case " %s " in *" $n "*) fail=1 ;; esac\n' "$real"
+    printf '  case " %s " in *" $n "*) fail=1; env_fail=1 ;; esac\n' "$envfail"
     printf '  n=$((n + 1))\ndone\n'
@@ -75,1 +77,7 @@
+run_legs "7" "" "" "$((TOTAL - 1))"
+expect "RED KS-1260 N62-1: a real leg-7 failure with the last leg never driven counts only the legs OBSERVED to run" "1 yes" "$RC $(has "($((TOTAL - 1))/$TOTAL legs ran)")"
+run_legs "7" "" "1"
+expect "RED KS-1260 N62-2a: a leg-1 failure with no install plus a real leg-7 failure also says Leg 1 could not RUN" "1 yes" "$RC $(has 'Leg 1 also could not RUN')"
+run_legs "" "" "" "$((TOTAL - 1))"
+expect "RED KS-1260 N62-2b: a clean run with the last leg never driven is INCOMPLETE, says NONE declared a skip, and exits 1" "1 yes" "$RC $(has 'NONE declared a skip')"

```

### READ THIS BEFORE YOU WRITE THE HUNKS

- In `run_legs` the `printf` format strings are single-quoted, so `$n` and `$TOTAL_LEGS` are written into `run.sh` literally and expand when `run.sh` runs. Keep the single quotes. `%s` is filled by the argument after the closing quote (`"$last"`, `"$envfail"`), exactly as the existing `skip_stack` and `fail=1` lines do.
- In the three cells the `has` argument of N62-1 is DOUBLE-quoted on purpose, so `$((TOTAL - 1))` and `$TOTAL` expand in the test; the other two are single-quoted fixed text. The `run_legs` call comes on the line BEFORE its `expect`.
- It is bash 3.2: no `mapfile`, no `declare -A`, no `timeout`, no `${x,,}`.

## Cells

- `observed` = `RED KS-1260 N62-1: a real leg-7 failure with the last leg never driven counts only the legs OBSERVED to run`
- `leg1note` = `RED KS-1260 N62-2a: a leg-1 failure with no install plus a real leg-7 failure also says Leg 1 could not RUN`

## Controls

## THE CELLS — state it to yourself before you write a line

At the untouched tip every cell passes, the three new ones included:
- `observed`: legs 1-14 are driven, leg 15 never is and declares no skip; leg 7 fails. `RAN_LEGS` holds 14 legs, so the early verdict ends `(14/15 legs ran)`, rc 1: `1 yes`. Under OLDFORMULA it prints `15 - 0 = 15`, `(15/15 legs ran)`: `1 no`, red.
- `leg1note`: leg 1 sets `fail=1; env_fail=1`, leg 7 sets `fail=1`. `FAILED_LEGS` is ` 1 7`; the verdict leaves leg 1 out of `real_failed` because `env_fail` is set (`:699`), so it takes the early branch on leg 7 and, because `env_fail` is set, prints the `Leg 1 also could not RUN` note (`:706-708`), rc 1: `1 yes`. Under ALSOLINENOOP the note is gone: `1 no`, red.
- `nonedeclared`: legs 1-14 driven, none fails, none skips. `n_skipped` 0 and `n_ran` 14 is not 15, so the verdict prints `PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE — 14/15 legs ran and NONE declared a skip.` and exits 1 (`:741-746`): `1 yes`. Under NONEDECLAREDEXIT0 it exits 0: `0 yes`, red.
Each tamper touches a path only its own cell drives: OLDFORMULA and ALSOLINENOOP sit in the early-failure branch that `nonedeclared` never reaches, and NONEDECLAREDEXIT0 sits after it. The existing cells drive all 15 legs with no env failure, where every one of the three tampers is invisible (that is the gap), so they stay green; the three CONTROLs are green under all three.

- **Premise: nothing pins the three.** Instrument: OLDFORMULA, ALSOLINENOOP and NONEDECLAREDEXIT0 WITHOUT the hunks each red **0 of 742** cells across all 40 suites, every suite rc 0 (the gate's 0-of-146 over 7 suites, widened to the whole shell corpus).
- **Premise: the harness change leaves the old cells as they were.** With the two new arguments left out, `last` is `$TOTAL` (the script's own `TOTAL_LEGS`, 15) and `envfail` is empty, so `run.sh` drives the same 15 legs. Instrument: tip + hunks, the suite prints 8 `ok` lines (the 5 old + 3 new), `8 passed, 0 failed`, rc 0.
- **Premise: TEST FILES ONLY.** The diff's only file headers are the suite's (`diff_file_headers` in the input; checker T2); `git apply --numstat` on the brief's own diff names ONE path, `…/__tests__/preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio.test.sh`, 10 added, 2 removed (the `local` line and the loop `printf`, both replaced).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# TESTS that preflight's failure verdict still names the legs that ran (KS-1260)
# =============================================================================
# KS-1209 added an early "PREFLIGHT FAILED on leg(s) N" verdict that exits
# before the closing block, so a real failure lost the "(N/TOTAL legs ran)"
# ratio that KS-1046 made part of every verdict. These cases build the KS-1209
# harness from preflight.sh's OWN lines - its state, its step() and
# _leg_concluded() helpers, and its closing verdict - drive all the legs through
# step(), and read the verdict. No leg body runs: no npm, no node, no network.
#
# Usage: bash Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__/preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio.test.sh
# =============================================================================

set -uo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PREFLIGHT="$HERE/../preflight/preflight.sh"
PASS=0
FAIL=0

expect() {
  local desc="$1" want="$2" got="$3"
  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then
    PASS=$((PASS + 1)); printf 'ok   %s\n' "$desc"
  else
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); printf 'FAIL %s\n       want "%s", got "%s"\n' "$desc" "$want" "$got"
  fi
}

tmp="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ks1260-ratio.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT INT TERM

# The product's own lines. helpers.sh: from `fail=0` up to the first leg (state
# and helper functions). verdict.sh: from the `n_stack=` line to the end of the file.
awk '/^fail=0$/{on=1} /^step "1\//{on=0} on' "$PREFLIGHT" > "$tmp/helpers.sh"
awk 'index($0, "n_stack=") == 1 {on=1} on' "$PREFLIGHT" > "$tmp/verdict.sh"
TOTAL="$(awk -F= '$1 == "TOTAL_LEGS" {print $2}' "$tmp/helpers.sh")"

# run_legs <legs that fail for real> <legs that skip (stack not up)>, each space-separated.
# Every leg goes through the script's own step(); a skipped leg calls the
# script's own skip_stack. Sets RC and writes $tmp/out.txt.
run_legs() {
  local real="$1" skipped="$2"
  {
    printf 'set -uo pipefail\nGATEWAY=http://127.0.0.1:9\n'
    cat "$tmp/helpers.sh"
    printf 'n=1\nwhile [ "$n" -le "$TOTAL_LEGS" ]; do\n  step "$n/$TOTAL_LEGS  leg $n"\n'
    printf '  case " %s " in *" $n "*) skip_stack ;; esac\n' "$skipped"
    printf '  case " %s " in *" $n "*) fail=1 ;; esac\n' "$real"
    printf '  n=$((n + 1))\ndone\n'
    cat "$tmp/verdict.sh"
  } > "$tmp/run.sh"
  bash "$tmp/run.sh" > "$tmp/out.txt" 2>&1
  RC=$?
}

has() { if grep -q -F -- "$1" "$tmp/out.txt"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }

expect "CONTROL the harness holds preflight's own state, step(), failure verdict and leg total" "yes yes yes yes" \
  "$(grep -q '^fail=0$' "$tmp/helpers.sh" && echo yes || echo no) $(grep -q '^step() {' "$tmp/helpers.sh" && echo yes || echo no) $(grep -q 'PREFLIGHT FAILED on leg(s)' "$tmp/verdict.sh" && echo yes || echo no) $([ "${TOTAL:-0}" -gt 1 ] && echo yes || echo no)"

run_legs "" ""
expect "CONTROL a run where nothing fails exits 0 and says PREFLIGHT PASSED" "0 yes" "$RC $(has 'PREFLIGHT PASSED')"

run_legs "7" ""
expect "CONTROL a real leg-7 failure is still named and still exits 1" "1 yes" "$RC $(has 'leg(s) 7')"

run_legs "7" ""
expect "🔴 a real leg-7 failure prints the ratio of legs that ran" "1 yes" "$RC $(has "($TOTAL/$TOTAL legs ran)")"

run_legs "7" "3"
expect "🔴 a real leg-7 failure with leg 3 skipped counts only the legs that ran" "1 yes" "$RC $(has "($((TOTAL - 1))/$TOTAL legs ran)")"

echo ""
echo "preflight_failure_verdict_keeps_ratio: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]
